verdict.rationale: Context windows are documented precisely per model: the grok-4.7 page states 500,000 tokens, the models/pricing tables carry a Context column per model, and GET /v1/models returns `context_length`. The pack does not document maximum output tokens per model, and there is no separate input-vs-output split, so the output half of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: per-model maximum output token limits, explicit input/output budget breakdown, independent corroboration of the documented limits.

support.subject: As a developer, every model's context window and token budgets are documented precisely — input/output limits per model, not marketing ranges

citations.quote: the grok-4.7 model page states "Context window: 500,000 tokens" under "At a glance", and the models/pricing tables carry a Context column per model
with a documented response schema carrying `aliases`, `context_length`, per-token prices, and a `capabilities` object
requests whose prompt reaches the listed token threshold are billed at the higher rate for all tokens in the request
